newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Leighton hits new high on contracts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton hits new high on contracts.

text.p: Shares in Australian building and mining contractor Leighton Holdings Ltd continued their strong share market run, hitting a fresh all-time high after it was awarded three mining contracts worth A$225 million.
At 3.25 p.m. (0525 GMT), Leighton shares were eight cents up at the high of A$5.70 on low volume.
Prior to the announcement the shares were two cents down at A$5.60.
Leighton's unit Thiess Contractors were awarded mining contracts in mines operated by MIM Holdings Ltd.
On Monday, Leighton's, which is 44.9 percent owned by German contractor Hochtief Ag, shares rose 30 cents to A$5.60.

One analyst said the new contracts could be worth about A$7.00 to A$8.00 million to Leighton's annual net profit. "So it looks like some people are putting those numbers into the share price," the analyst said.
